concept.name: Design concept
concept.text: Designed, but not yet tried by the people it is for.

test.name: Simulation or test
test.text: Tried in a drill, simulation or small trial.

reported.name: Reported, not evaluated
reported.text: Described by those running it or in the news; nobody independent has checked the results.

guidance.name: Official guidance or data
guidance.text: What a government or UN agency advises or counts. It shows what is expected, not what works.

measured.name: Measured in a study
measured.text: A study, survey or analysis measured it, often the size of the problem rather than the effect of the fix.

evaluated.name: Independently evaluated
evaluated.text: Someone outside the programme measured whether the action worked.
